agent_answers: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "ClassPathResource", "method": "getInputStream", "explanation": "The getInputStream method directly uses the path field, which originates from System.getenv(...) without any path normalization or containment checks, allowing attacker-controlled data to reach the ClassLoader.getResourceAsStream(String) sink."}]}

{"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "ClassPathResource", "method": "ClassPathResource", "explanation": "The constructor applies only StringUtils.cleanPath to the untrusted path, which normalizes separators but does not remove or block directory traversal sequences like '..'.
